direct_predictions.prior: Lanz et al. 2025 describe hDeltaK and PFG neurons as recurrently connected. MaleCNS Cell Type Explorer names the 18-neuron population PFGs.
Reciprocal structural support is predicted by the recurrent hDeltaK-PFG model.
Exploratory test retained from goal-relay-audit-v1; not required for the recurrent-memory claim.
Tests whether the corrected PFGs population has direct structural access to PFL3 in MaleCNS.

claim_boundary: Alias-resolution structural audit only. The original exact PFG selector returning zero remains part of the audit history. PFGs is tested separately because the current MaleCNS catalog uses that type name for an 18-neuron population matching the literature population count. Structural recurrence does not establish persistent activity, working memory, sign, gating dynamics, or behavioral function.
